purpose: Pre-game controller reservations for lobby create/join and smart-bot gap filling. The tested backend still performs the real hidden Starting Card deal at game.start.

flow.create: Reserve the joining human's controller role immediately from their lobby seat.
flow.join: Reserve the joining human's controller role immediately from their lobby seat.
flow.start: Host reconciles occupied seat reservations, creates smart guest-bots for missing reserved-role seats, then calls the existing backend game.start action.
flow.afterStart: Backend hidden role is authoritative; each smart bot switches to the bot module matching the role actually dealt by the backend.
